definitions.explanation: A device for sharpening pencils, whether hand-held, desktop, or electric.

examples.japanese: {鉛筆削|えんぴつけず}りを{貸|か}して。
{電動|でんどう}の{鉛筆削|えんぴつけず}りは{便利|べんり}だ。
examples.english: An electric pencil sharpener is convenient.

examples.japanese: {小学校|しょうがっこう}に{入|はい}る{前|まえ}に、{鉛筆削|えんぴつけず}りを{買|か}っておかなければならない。
examples.english: I need to buy a pencil sharpener before starting elementary school.

notes:
{鉛筆削|えんぴつけず}り is a compound of {鉛筆|えんぴつ} (pencil) and {削|けず}り (shaving/sharpening), referring to any device used to sharpen pencils.

TYPES:
- {手動|しゅどう}{鉛筆削|えんぴつけず}り: manual pencil sharpener (hand-held or crank)
- {電動|でんどう}{鉛筆削|えんぴつけず}り: electric pencil sharpener

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {鉛筆削|えんぴつけず}りで{削|けず}る: to sharpen with a pencil sharpener
- {鉛筆削|えんぴつけず}りを{使|つか}う: to use a pencil sharpener

CULTURAL NOTE:
A standard item on elementary school supply lists ({入学準備|にゅうがくじゅんび}) in Japan, where pencils are still widely used. Japanese students often use hand-crank desktop models at home and small portable ones at school.
